intermediate.verbatim:
The Intermediate license applicant must also:
• Present proof of identity; 
• Pass a vision screening and a driving skills test (The 
driving skills test may be waived if the applicant has 
completed an approved driver education course);
• Have a minor’s release signed by a parent or legal 
guardian; and pay the required fee.

correction.reason: Disambiguate fee payment by the applicant from the parent or guardian signature; preserve required modality, actor choices and fee unknown.

fact.before: An intermediate-license applicant must have a parent or legal guardian sign the minor's release and pay the required fee.
fact.after: The intermediate-license applicant must pay the required fee and obtain a minor's release signed by a parent or legal guardian.
fact.manual_verdict: SOURCE_SUPPORTED: the applicant must have the release signed by a parent or legal guardian and pay the fee. The rewrite makes the fee actor explicit without a fee amount, new condition or changed modality.
